CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AJAY DIGPAUL  ORDER % 05.12.2025 1.

Through the present petition, the petitioner seeks setting aside of the order dated 18.11.2025,
whereby the learned ASJ, Central district, Tis Hazari Courts modified the sentence to the extent that the petitioner, along with two co-convicts namely Salim and Mohd. Jahid, shall undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of six months along with a fine of Rs. 10,000/- each, and in default thereof, shall undergo simple imprisonment for two months.

2. The petitioner further seeks quashing of the order of conviction dated 06.01.2024, whereby the petitioner, along with other co-accused persons, was convicted for the offences punishable under Section 420/511/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 in case FIR No. 826/2014 registered at PS Timarpur, as well as the order on sentence dated 05.06.2024.
3.
While passing the order dated 18.11.2025, the learned ASJ directed This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/12/2025 at 20:47:23 the petitioner and the other two convicts to surrender before the learned Trial Court within one week for undergoing the aforesaid sentence, failing which the learned Trial Court was requested to ensure their presence and secure execution of the sentence.

4. Today, the petitioner is in default of the said directions, as he has not surrendered in terms of order dated 18.11.2025.
5.
Let the matter be listed on 08.12.2025.
